plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Huawei AR router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, optical modules, interface traffic, voltage, and power (enterprise PEN 2011).
name: Router

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Huawei AR router entities (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityCpuUsage, averaged across entities). Sustained high CPU usage may indicate control-plane overload or routing churn.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory-buffer utilization of the Huawei AR router entities (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityMemUsage, reported directly as a percentage and averaged across entities). High memory pressure can affect forwarding and route processing.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the chassis temperature in degrees Celsius of the Huawei AR router, aggregated as the maximum across sensors. High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Per-entity input voltage of the Huawei AR router (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName, sharing hwEntityStateTable with CPU/memory/temperature. Distinct from optical-module voltage device_optical_voltage (hwEntityOpticalVoltage). Values outside the rated range may indicate unstable power and hardware risk.

metrics.name: device_entity_board_power
metrics.description: Board power consumption of each Huawei AR entity (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityBoardPower), in watts. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Some AR SKUs omit this leaf and the table stays empty. Unexpected rise can indicate a failing board, abnormal traffic load, or a cooling problem that increases power draw.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the fan state of the Huawei AR router, normalized via telegraf processors.enum so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum across fans so any faulty fan surfaces.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan speed of each Huawei AR cooling fan (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityFanSpeed), reported as a percentage of full speed. Shares the hwFanStatusTable index with device_fan_state. Persistently high speed can indicate thermal compensation; a drop toward 0% with a healthy state may still mean a stalled rotor.

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical receive power in dBm (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalRxPower). AR routers report µW on the wire (MIB text often says dBm). Telegraf stores raw µW and this query converts with 10*log10(µW/1000), dropping <=0 and the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical transmit power in dBm (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalTxPower). AR routers report µW on the wire (MIB text often says dBm). Telegraf stores raw µW and this query converts with 10*log10(µW/1000), dropping <=0 and the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone.

metrics.name: device_optical_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature of each Huawei AR optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalTemperature), in degrees Celsius. The query drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. High module temperature accelerates laser aging and can precede optical power failure.

metrics.name: device_optical_bias
metrics.description: Laser bias current of each Huawei AR optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalBiasCurrent), in microamperes (µA) as reported on the wire. The query drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Drift away from the normal range is an early sign of a failing transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_voltage
metrics.description: Supply voltage of each Huawei AR optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts and drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Distinct from per-entity device_voltage_volts (hwEntityVoltage). Out-of-range voltage can cause unstable optics.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the power-supply state of the Huawei AR router, normalized via telegraf processors.enum so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum across supplies so any failed PSU surfaces.

metrics.name: device_energy_current_power_mw
metrics.description: Instantaneous chassis energy of the Huawei AR router (hwCurrentPower), in milliwatts (mW). Divide by 1000 to display watts.

metrics.name: device_energy_average_power_mw
metrics.description: Period-average chassis energy of the Huawei AR router (hwAveragePower), in milliwatts (mW). Divide by 1000 to display watts.

metrics.name: device_energy_rated_power_mw
metrics.description: Rated chassis energy of the Huawei AR router (hwRatedPower), in milliwatts (mW). Divide by 1000 to display watts.

metrics.name: device_board_current_power_mw
metrics.description: Instantaneous energy of each Huawei AR board (hwBoardCurrentPower), in milliwatts (mW). Divide by 1000 to display watts. Dimension hwBoardName is the board name. Rows with empty board name or invalid sentinel -1 are dropped. Distinct from device_entity_board_power (hwEntityBoardPower, watts).

metrics.name: device_board_rated_power_mw
metrics.description: Rated energy of each Huawei AR board (hwBoardRatedPower), in milliwatts (mW). Divide by 1000 to display watts. Dimension hwBoardName is the board name. Rows with empty board name or invalid sentinel -1 are dropped. Distinct from device_entity_board_power (hwEntityBoardPower, watts).

metrics.name: device_power_used
metrics.description: Chassis-level used power of the Huawei AR router (hwDevicePowerInfoUsedPower), in watts. Rising used power against a stable total budget indicates growing load or a hardware inefficiency. Distinct from device_energy_*_mw milliwatt energy gauges.

metrics.name: device_power_total
metrics.description: Chassis-level total power capacity of the Huawei AR router (hwDevicePowerInfoTotalPower), in watts. Used as the denominator when judging how close the chassis is to its power budget. Distinct from device_energy_*_mw milliwatt energy gauges.

metrics.name: interface_ifAdminStatus
metrics.description: This metric indicates the administrative status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: This metric reflects the actual operational status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifSpeed
metrics.description: This metric indicates the maximum data transmission speed supported by the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of incoming unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.
